hypothesis: Same-account past-only context in all roles may improve detection over the frozen global-only policy; improvement is not assumed.
changed_factor: History availability only; identical base inputs, targets, account groups, endpoint population, models, seed, hyperparameters and calibration objective.
population: original primary train only; original primary validation and test excluded before feature building

cv.group_unit: frozen incident-connected accounts; overlapping windows stay within account/group
cv.splitter: StratifiedGroupKFold; use the first inner split deterministically, never choose it by metrics
cv.fitting: refit global profile, vocabulary, scaler and model on inner fit only; emit-before-update personal history in every role
cv.calibration: inner validation only for numeric threshold and LSTM epoch
cv.assessment: frozen candidate inference; process denies assessment.csv until candidate completion

epoch_ties: higher F1, higher recall, lower FPR; keep earliest exact tie
lstm_score: unchanged mean squared reconstruction error over every feature and all five days
training_roles: RF labeled inner fit; IF background inner-fit days; LSTM all-background inner-fit windows
reporting: every fold/policy/model including zero recall and negative differences
within-fold PR-AUC, precision, recall, F1, FPR, TP/FP/FN/TN, support and coverage
paired fold deltas and fold mean/sample-SD/min/max; dependent folds are not independent samples
each primary train endpoint assessed exactly once per policy/model
pooled decisions and per-scenario recall; do not pool uncalibrated cross-fold scores into PR/ROC AUC
all exact numerical inputs, window memberships, predictions, checkpoints, thresholds, source/config/environment hashes and worker guards
limits: One model seed, reused development folds and overlapping training partitions; no model selection from outer metrics within this series and no independent confirmation. Scenario 3 has very few independent groups.
test_policy: CERT test was consumed on 2026-11-13. No prepared test reads, transformations, scoring or threshold selection here. The source CSV/context is co-located and verified before filtering primary train.
